Fight for Trotro asset credits

Human characters and locomotion animations
Microsoft Rocketbox Avatar Library, Copyright (c) 2020 Microsoft.
https://github.com/microsoft/Microsoft-Rocketbox
MIT License. Full notice included in characters/LICENSE.txt.
Models: Male_Adult_12, Male_Adult_04, Male_Adult_17, Male_Child_02,
Female_Child_02, Female_Adult_15, Construction_Male_07, Business_Male_05,
Female_Adult_02, Construction_Male_05, Medical_Female_01, Sports_Male_03,
Delivery_Male_01. Original fictional game identities are assigned to these
licensed stock models; they do not identify real Accra residents.
Motion: m_walk_fast_01, m_idle_breathe_01.
Modifications: resized/converted textures, PBR materials, in-place motion,
normalized rig names, live-rendered selection portraits,
and procedural combat poses. These characters are licensed stock humans,
not scans of Accra residents.

Asphalt 02 by Rob Tuytel / Poly Haven.
https://polyhaven.com/a/asphalt_02
CC0 1.0 Universal: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
Diffuse, OpenGL normal and roughness textures at 1K resolution.
Assets are bundled locally; the game does not call the Poly Haven API.

Three.js r170, FBXLoader, SkeletonUtils, RoundedBoxGeometry and NURBS helpers
MIT License. Notice included in ../vendor/three-LICENSE.txt.
fflate by Arjun Barrett, MIT license, copyright notice in vendor source.

Barlow and Barlow Condensed by Jeremy Tribby
SIL Open Font License. Full notices included in ../vendor/.

Environment structures, minibus, props, game rules and interface are
constructed for this prototype. No Google Maps or Street View imagery
or extracted geometry is included.
